questions.question: Which Scandinavian country shares its entire eastern land border with Sweden?
questions.fun_fact: Norway shares a 1,619-kilometer-long border with Sweden, making it the longest land border in Europe west of Russia.

questions.question: What is the powerhouse of the cell responsible for generating most of the chemical energy needed to power biochemical reactions?
questions.fun_fact: Mitochondria possess their own independent DNA that is separate from the nuclear DNA of the cell.

questions.question: The Magna Carta was signed and sealed by King John in which year?
questions.fun_fact: Although only three original clauses of the Magna Carta remain valid in English law today, it laid the foundational principles for modern constitutional governance.

questions.question: Which classic 1941 animated Disney film features a young circus elephant with unusually large ears who learns to fly?
questions.fun_fact: At just 64 minutes long, Dumbo is one of the shortest feature-length films in Disney's animation history.

questions.question: What is the primary ingredient in the traditional Greek dip known as tzatziki?
questions.fun_fact: Tzatziki is typically made using strained sheep or goat milk yogurt mixed with salted cucumbers, garlic, salt, and olive oil.

questions.question: What unique physical characteristic distinguishes the animal group known as monotremes from all other mammals?
options: They lay eggs instead of giving birth to live young
questions.fun_fact: The platypus and the echidna are the only surviving species of monotremes left on Earth.

questions.question: How many players are on the field for a single association football (soccer) team during a standard regulation match?
questions.fun_fact: The 11-player rule per team has been a standard regulation of association football established by the International Football Association Board since the 19th century.

questions.question: What linguistic term is used to describe words like 'night' and 'knight' that sound identical but have different meanings and spellings?
questions.fun_fact: While all homophones share the same pronunciation, they can either share the same spelling (homographs) or have different spellings (heterographs).

questions.question: Which planet in our solar system features the Great Dark Spot, a massive storm system comparable in size to Earth?
questions.fun_fact: First discovered by the Voyager 2 spacecraft in 1989, Neptune's Great Dark Spot was later observed to have completely vanished when viewed by the Hubble Space Telescope in 1994.

questions.question: The autonomous region of Greenland is an overseas territory belonging to which European country?
questions.fun_fact: Despite being geographically part of the North American continent, Greenland has maintained deep political and cultural ties to the Kingdom of Denmark for centuries.
